# Public form (intake)

**When to use this** — Submitting a Quick Request or other published intake form without signing into Prioritize.

## Steps

1. Open the form URL you were given (`/f/<slug>`), e.g. Quick Request.
2. Fill required fields. Pick **Requested by** when you need a HireClix teammate to own updates.
3. Submit. You should see a confirmation (and often an email) that it was received.
4. Internally, the item lands in triage for PM/BA — they claim, assign, or convert it to a project.
5. If you have a [client portal](/pm/help?guide=external/client-portal) link for related work, track progress there; otherwise ask your HireClix contact.

## Done when

The form confirms success and your requester/contact knows it was filed.

## If this happens

- **Error on submit** — retry once; if it fails again, send the details to your HireClix PM (slug + time).
- **No confirmation email** — check spam; the team can still see the submission in Inbox.
